FEA-SF-19.text:
Full, enterprise-grade roles and access control, not a basic set with a proxy in the meantime.

Both RichView servers, Cowork and Publish, have a governance section where an admin manages users, roles and who can see, edit, delete and share each report, at the level enterprises expect. They get it from the server core they share. The protection is the same wherever the server runs: hosted by RichView, in a customer's container, or on the customer's own server.

The CLI, MCP server and VS Code extension need no account; to publish, the command line keeps a sign-in per server that you can remove with richview logout. Reports are served from a separate report origin before read protection ships (ARC-15). Agents decide the technical details, such as the identity source, single sign-on and audit logging, to meet the enterprise bar.

FEA-SF-30.text:
The home page promises what the product will do. No hotfixes to the live page: it was never advertised, so it simply changes when the rewrite reaches `prod`.

| Statement | Decision |
| --- | --- |
| The report menu: share, copy and protect each one; the "private" badge | Kept. The menu gets built (FEA-SF-18), with protection from the enterprise roles (FEA-SF-19). |
| VS Code snippets per style | Not important; worded to match what ships. |
| "One shortcut to publish" | Becomes one-click publish, which the product gets, including right-click publish in the editor (INT-83). |
| "The coming release includes the CLI, MCP tools, report server and extension" | Kept: they all ship. |
| Open source | "RichView is open source and MIT licensed." (INT-37) |
| "Versions are immutable; the latest address points to the current one." | Kept, and made true (TYP-64, TYP-96). |
| Style names | Name the styles that ship, taken from core (STY-05, DEL-18). |
| Release updates and the consent text | Kept: subscribers get release updates. |
| The flagship verdict quote | Removed; the section links the report (INT-45). |
| The Hacker News dots caption | Shown only while the page renders the dots (STY-44). |
